text: Benchmark the aimparency harness against a plain coding agent on an external long-horizon benchmark
description: Research cycle 2026-11-08 (Multi-step SWE: 69 tasks, each 5-15 dependent steps on one codebase; Beyond Final Scores, arXiv 2608.13417; Terminal-Bench). Same model, two conditions: plain CLI agent with the task vs the aimparency harness (decompose, context, verify, reflect). Start with ~20 tasks to control cost; pre-register metrics (verified completion, cost, rework). Distinct from 8ac03697 (which tested graph context in a wrapped agent on self-made single-session tasks and found a ceiling) and complementary to 926212fd: this tests the harness on an outside benchmark built for long chains. Reuse the paired-run contract ae0e65f3.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 research cycle. Needs the harness stage machine first.
